page_title: ROM 1-0 MON | AS Roma v Monza 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The match has just finished.
90+11' That was really pointless. Jose Mourinho (AS Roma) was being offensive and couldn't control himself. He gave Giovanni Ayroldi no choice but to send him off.
90+7' Booking. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) receives a caution from the referee.
90+2' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 21:10.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
89' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance!
87' Having seen unsporting behavior, Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Raffaele Palladino (Monza) is the recipient.
85' Here comes a substitution. Georgios Kyriakopoulos is given a rest as he is replaced by Giulio Donati (Monza).
84' Pablo Mari (Monza) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after the corner and unleashes a shot which flies well wide of the right post.
84' Good work from Monza as they win a corner.
83' Samuele Vignato (Monza) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
82' Pablo Mari (Monza) is able to continue to play.
80' Pablo Mari (Monza) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
80' The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
80' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Leonardo Spinazzola as he is replaced by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma).
78' A yellow card for a tackle by Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma). Giovanni Ayroldi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
76' Samuele Vignato (Monza) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Rui Patricio.
73' Jose Mourinho has decided to make a change. Diego Llorente (AS Roma) replaces Evan Ndicka.
73' Today's match ends for Rick Karsdorp who will be replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).

73' What a chance that is! Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post!
72' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
70' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) for a tough tackle.
70' Dany Mota (Monza) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
69' Looks like Dany Mota (Monza) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
67' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

66' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! The referee signals a corner kick to Monza.
65' That's unlucky! Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Dany Mota (Monza) for Lorenzo Colombo.
64' Substitution. Samuele Vignato (Monza) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Andrea Colpani walks off.
63' Jose Mourinho prepares a substitution. Edoardo Bove is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
63' Substitution. Andrea Belotti makes way for Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
60' A corner kick by AS Roma is thwarted by the well prepared Michele Di Gregorio (Monza).
60' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Houssem Aouar (AS Roma). AS Roma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma).
57' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
56' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
54' Luca Caldirola (Monza) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. AS Roma earn a free kick.
53' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' The game is interrupted now, Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

50' What a great effort! Andrea Colpani (Monza) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
48' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is coming onto the pitch as Pedro Pereira cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.

45+3' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+2' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+2' What a wasted opportunity by Andrea Belotti (AS Roma)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Michele Di Gregorio makes a decent save to thwart him.
45+2' Here's the change. Jose Machin leaves the pitch and Andrea Carboni (Monza) comes on as a substitute.
45+2' Jose Machin (Monza) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
41' RED CARD! Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Giovanni Ayroldi. He can have an early bath.
39' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.

37' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Michele Di Gregorio shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
34' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
28' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post.
25' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
23' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) sees a yellow card from Giovanni Ayroldi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
22' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
21' Luca Caldirola (Monza) is penalised for a foul. Giovanni Ayroldi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' Jose Machin (Monza) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
20' Pedro Pereira (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Monza earn a corner.
19' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. Monza will have a chance to score from a corner.
16' Some neat passing and movement from Monza as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
12' Andrea Colpani (Monza) sends a long ball in, but Rui Patricio comfortably gathers the ball.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) heads on.
8' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giovanni Ayroldi no option but to blow his whistle.
6' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
6' AS Roma take a short corner kick.
6' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
4' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes the direct free kick from far out, but his shot flies into the stands.
2' An attempted cross from Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) is cleared.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
